g.text: One ResourceManager for the whole cluster;
one NodeManager on every worker machine.
1. The client hands the job to the ResourceManager.
2. The RM gives the job room on Worker 1 for its own coordinator,
the ApplicationMaster (one per job, this job only).
The AM asks the RM for room to run 4 map tasks.
It only asks; the RM decides which workers get them.
The RM hands out room on all three workers.
Each NodeManager starts the map tasks placed on its machine.
3. The AM tracks progress of every task, on every worker.
If a task fails, the AM asks for room to rerun it.
All 4 map tasks are done (gray). Their output waits on local disk
The AM asks for room for 1 reduce task; the RM places it on Worker 3.
Reduce done, so the job is done. YARN decided WHERE each task ran.
